x: It leaves me to say that I want to see the arrival of our 'young promises' such as Morris, Bennett, Maxwell, Dunsford, Robson, Miss Jane Pritchard, Miss Anna Matthews and Miss Diana Cook bursting onto the scene.

Highly placed in the 5km walk were (left to right) Anna Matthews 3rd/31:00, Wendy Dunsford 6th/35:22 and Diane Cook 5th/33:39; with Jane Pritchard (right) first home in the under 15 2.5km group and Barbara Dunsford (not in picture) 5th.

Left: Anna Matthews (8) and Diane Cook (1) competed in the Senior Ladies 3,000 metre walk at the Club Championships. Right: Junior David Bailey had good cause to smile after collecting his haul of trophies at the end of the meeting.

Diane Cook was third home in the Women's 10Km and Jane Pritchard was in action in the intermediate girls 5Km. August 20th saw Carl successfully tackling the South Western Counties 10Km at Weymouth, winning in 46:46, while over the London Vidarians 5 mile course Graham Seatter zipped to a record 34:59.
Unfortunately on the first lap our other policewoman, Diane Cook, who had incidentally been on night duty all week, came under the judges ban - giving our team hopes a bit of a blow.

Our Walkers, however, have competed in three major championships, the first being the National Junior 5000m at Milksham in November, where Diane Cook finished 6th in her first championship race for the Club and Anna Matthews was unfortunately disqualified while fighting out for 3rd place.
Diane Cook was the highest placed of our ladies on April 8th at Ewell gaining 2nd over 3Km in the Senior Surrey Ladies Championship with 19:21.
